purpose: Complete comparison families inspected for the five new support articles and the new kanji notes: alternative conjunctions, guide/information/booklet scope, comet versus meteor, hawk versus eagle, jasmine and broom spellings.
limits: Supplement to the unchanged 40-family pilot packet, not an exhaustive vocabulary inventory. The same-spelling 冊子/そうし family is retained separately from 冊子/さっし; no reading or sense is borrowed across them. Entry 1552200's horse-marking sense is not taught as an astronomical meaning. Comparison articles themselves remain unchanged.
